comparison.objective: Fit a cable-tray lid; candidate commissions an industrial-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-cover alignment and seating versus small recessed-tool insertion, collar manipulation, counterholding, torque control, and iterative impact assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly seated tray lid is implied; candidate requires two safe stops and verified retained adjustment. Lid engagement and damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: The record tests closure fitting rather than damping-force adjustment and dynamic validation.
